items.label: Profile
items.content: Senior technical and marketing leader with 9+ years delivering development and marketing solutions for teams across augmented and virtual reality, SaaS, entertainment, and higher education. Track record shipping complex multi-platform products on time, managing distributed teams across cutting-edge projects

jobs.title: Fractional Head of XR Development
bullets: Embedded as technical lead to build ELIXR's internal XR development capacity from scratch, created department SOPs, hiring frameworks, project management systems, tech stacks, and client communication tools.
Led XR product discovery and development for major institutional clients including NAIT, the City of Calgary, and the Edmonton Chinatown Association.
Handled full-lifecycle scoping, risk management, hiring, and client-facing communication across all active projects.

jobs.org: NAIT: AI + VR Nursing Training Tool
jobs.title: Senior Technical Lead
bullets: Led design and development of an AI-enabled VR tool for training nurses on structured communication protocol (SBAR).
Implemented an AI assessment loop grading nurses on communication proficiency in real time.

jobs.org: Edmonton Chinatown Heritage Association: AR Art App
jobs.title: Senior Technical Lead
bullets: Led design and development of a phone-based AR app showcasing historic Chinatown art, users scan local murals to reveal 3D AR animations and unlock rewards from local businesses.

jobs.org: City of Calgary: WAVE Technology Centre
jobs.title: XR Discovery Project, Senior Technical Lead
bullets: Led design and delivery of four proof-of-concept XR projects: VR training simulator, collocated Mixed Reality tool, smart-glasses reporting tool, and 360 video viewer.
Owned full project lifecycle from discovery and scoping through design, development, testing, and delivery.

jobs.org: Red Deer Polytechnic & Alberta Sports Hall of Fame
jobs.title: Senior Technical Lead
bullets: Led design and development of an immersive projector-based wheelchair curling simulator for permanent installation at the Alberta Sports Hall of Fame.
Planned on-site UX, led physical installation design, managed development teams across Unity simulation and OpenCV computer vision stone tracking.

jobs.org: Chaos Inc., Tech & Marketing Consulting Studio
jobs.title: Partner & Studio Lead
bullets: Founded and operate a boutique tech and marketing consultancy focused on immersive technology, senior fractional leadership, and performance marketing. Handling sales, staffing, project management, and finance.

jobs.title: Internal Project - Technical Lead
bullets: Led design and development of a collocated free-roam educational VR experience based on the James Webb Space Telescope; ran at Telus World of Science and published to 400+ VR arcades across North America and the EU.
TWOS pilot metrics: 603 guests · 73.5% utilization · 4.84/5 satisfaction · NPS 84.3.
Negotiated LBE partnership structures including time-limited, performance-gated exclusivity terms.
Invited to speak on LBE panel at GamesCon Canada (Brent Bushnell / Two Bit Circus).
Nominated for the Telus World of Science, Science Fellow Award for 2026.

jobs.org: Fabutan, Canada's Largest Tanning Chain (90+ locations)
jobs.title: Senior Marketing Advisor
bullets: Managed full audit and rebuild of marketing department including media buying plans and creative strategy.
Rebuilt paid media and attribution systems, reducing tracked acquisition cost from $72 to $22.
Developed an ad automation tool reducing time to publish Meta and Google ads across 90 locations by 60%+.

jobs.title: Senior Development & Marketing Lead
bullets: Led marketing and development teams to build and launch an in-school, free-roam VR fieldtrip platform. Taking it from concept to revenue in 6 months.
Architected the free-roam VR software and marketing strategy that secured a partnership with the ISS National Laboratory.
Drove sustained ticket demand for multi-location VR attractions through paid media and partnership development.
Content deployed with operators across the EU, Australia, the US, and Canada.
Work directly led to a successful seed stage raise, and an eventual partnership with the International Space Station Laboratory.

jobs.title: GTM & Paid Advertising Lead
bullets: Led the creation of the PPC system for an AI-first property development SaaS.
Built advertising, targeting, and attribution framework; ran test campaigns across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn delivering key KPI targets.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
bullets: Rebuilt full Google Ads tracking, targeting, and reporting system, raising ROAS from 3.6x to 5.8x over 3 months.
Shifted reporting focus from top-of-funnel leads to booked and completed jobs via custom ServiceTitan integration.
Implemented Searchlight for cross-channel attribution across a structured 6-month measurement window.

jobs.org: The Winston, Calgary Premium Golf Course
jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
bullets: Led strategy to acquire leads for $30k shareholder memberships through paid media and email funnels.
Reduced cost per qualified lead from $300 to $90 over 6 months.

jobs.org: VRKADE, Western Canada's Largest VR Arcade Chain
jobs.title: Senior Marketing Lead
bullets: Led full-funnel paid media strategy across Meta and Google, reducing customer acquisition cost from $85 to $17.
Developed high-value partnership with national mall chain driving $100k/year in incremental profit for flagship location.
Led full rebrand and online marketing overhaul; work featured by HTC.

jobs.title: Marketing Automation Consultant
bullets: Led UI design of a web-based property exploration portfolio covering 100+ mall properties across Canada.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
bullets: Paid campaign added 50k followers and 30k engaged email subscribers.
Built custom web-based VIN decoding tool for list engagement.

jobs.title: Marketing Automation Consultant
bullets: Designed custom quoting automation generating personalized branded PDF quotes, estimated 4% revenue lift.

jobs.title: Freelance · Various Artists
bullets: Led EP production for 2013 Miss Universe Canada, Risa Santos.
Recorded with platinum record producer Nygel Asselin (Half Moon Run).
Co-produced and performed a track on MuchMusic.
Performed 300+ shows on luxury cruise lines across Europe.
Transitioned to technology entrepreneurship applying performance discipline, systems thinking, and pattern recognition to product development.
